newsitem.title: CHINA: China Yanjing beer brand name valued at $67 mln.
newsitem.headline: China Yanjing beer brand name valued at $67 mln.

text.p: The brand name of China's biggest brewer Yanjing Beer Group Co, which will issue shares this week, has been officially valued at more than 560 million yuan ($67 million), the Beijing Economic Daily said on Wednesday.
The State Administration for Industry and Commerce had named Yanjing one of China's "famous brands", prompting officials to value the group's brand name, the newspaper said.
The Beijing Economic Daily gave no details of how officials had calculated the value of Yanjing's brand name, which it gave as 560.883 million yuan.
Yanjing Beer Group Co is scheduled to issue 72 million domestic currency A shares for the group's Yanjing Beer Shareholding Co on June 6, state media said at the weekend.
The shares are to be priced at 7.34 yuan each and the issue is expected to raise 570 million yuan.
Yanjing controls 85 percent of the Beijing beer market and brewed 571,000 tonnes of beer last year, up 68.2 percent from 1995, figures released earlier showed.
The firm's pre-tax profits soared 58.2 percent to 357.99 million yuan in 1996.
